senses.gloss:
n. (-नं)
The nut of the Strychnos. See अम्बुप्रसादन.

n. (-नं)
1 Obtaining, attaining.
2 Accomplishing.
3 Going to or toward.
E.
आङ् before षद to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

r. 5th cl. (ऊ.) अशू (अश्नुते)
1 To pervade or occupy.
2 To heap or crowd.
r. 9th cl. (अश्नाति)
To eat, to eat hungrily.
With प्र prefixed,
to begin to eat.

r. 1st cl. (असति-ते)
1 To go or move.
2 To take or receive.
3 To shine: see अस.

(ञ) r. 1st cl. (असति-ते)
1 To go or move.
2 To take or receive.
3 To shine.
(ल) r. 2d cl. (अस्ति)
To be.
(य, उ, इर) r. 4th cl. (अस्यति-ते)
To throw or direct.
With अनु prefixed,
to sit down:
with अप,
to quit or abandon:
with नि,
to deposit:
with निर्,
to expel:
with परि and उप,
to sit around:
with प्र,
to throw away, to reject, to confute:
with वि,
to divide:
with वि and आङ्,
to class, to arrange:
with सम and नि,
to abandon the world:
with सम,
to collect, to combine or compound.

f. (-शा)
1 Hope, desire.
2 Length.
3 A quarter, a region.
E.
आङ् before अशू to expand, अच् and टाप् affs.

r. 2d cl. (आस्ते or आसते^1)
1 To sit.
2 To be present.
3 To be or exist.
With अधि prefixed.
1 To inhabit, to dwell in.
2 To sit over or upon.
3 To mistake or err by taking one thing for another from similarity of appearance.
With अभि,
to sit or apply to, to study, to learn.
With उत्,
1 To leave, to abandon.
2 To shake, agitate, &c. (as wind.)
With उप,
to worship, to do homage.
With निर्,
to expel.
With प्र and निर्,
to reject, to refute, to invalidate.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301. note: cf mw, pwg.

m. (-सः)
A bow.
E.
अस to send or throw, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Unable, incompetent.
E.
अ neg. शक्त able, strong.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Detached, disunited.
2 Not interested in, indifferent to, unattached to.
3 Detached from worldly feelings and passions.
E.
अ neg. सक्त united.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Able, powerful.
E.
आङ् and शक्त able.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Zealously following or pursuing, intent or attached strongly to.
2 Trusting to, confiding in.
3 Eternal.
adv. n. (-क्तं)
Eternally.
E.
आङ्, षञ्ज to embrace, to move, participial affix क्त.

f. (-ता)
Weakness, inability.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, अशक्तत्वं.

f. (-क्तिः)
Inability, incapability, weakness, impotence.
E.
अ neg. शक्ति power.

f. (-क्तिः)
Power, ability, might.
E.
आङ् before शक्ति power.

f. (-क्तिः)
Attachment to one object or pursuit, diligence, application.
E.
आङ् before षञ्ज to embrace, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
1 Impossible, impracticable.
2 Not to be made.
E.
अ neg. शक्य possible.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
1 Fearless, undaunted.
2 Secure, certain.
E.
अ neg. शङ्का fear.

f. (-ङ्का)
1 Fear, apprehension.
2 Doubt, uncertainty.
E.
आङ्, शकि to doubt, अच् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Certain, undoubted.
2 Fearless.
E.
अ neg. शङ्कित alarmed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Feared, dreaded.
2 Doubted.
E.
आङ् before शकि to doubt, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं)
Virtuous, good.
E.
अ neg. शठ wicked.

mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु)
Friendly.
m. (-त्रुः)
A name of the moon.
E.
अ neg. and शत्रु an enemy; who has.

m. (-नः)
A plant, (Pentaptera tomentosa, Rox.)
n. (-नं)
1 Food.
2 Eating: also असन.
E.
अश to eat, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
n. (-नं)
Throwing, sending.
E.
अस to expel (disease), to send, to throw, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) see असन and आसन.

n. (-नं)
1 A stool, a seat.
2 Maintaining a post against an enemy.
3 The withers of an elephant, the part where the driver sits.
4 Halting, stopping.
5 Sitting in some peculiar posture, as in the custom of devotees, &c. eighty-four kinds are enumerated: see पद्मासन, &c.
m. (-नः)
A tree, (Pentapheca tomentosa.) also असन
f. (-ना-नी)
Stay, abiding, sitting.
(-नी)
1 A shop, a stall.
2 A small seat, a stool.
E.
आस to abide, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Near, proximate.
m. (-न्नः)
A setting sun.
E.
आङ्, षद to go, and क्त aff.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant: also असनपर्णी.

f. (-र्णी)
The name of a plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
E.
असन and पर्ण a leaf; having leaves like the Asana.

f. (-या)
Hunger.
E.
अशन food, क्यच् affix, अ and टाप् added, and the penultimate made long: wishing for food.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungry.
E.
as before इतच् added.

mfn. (-निः-निः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
अश to eat, अनि Uṇādi affix; what eats or consumes rocks, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Bodiless, incorporeal.
m. (-रः)
A name of KĀMA or love.
E.
अ neg. शरीर body.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Incorporeal.
E.
अ neg. शरीरिन् embodied.

n. (-र्म्म)
Pain, affliction.
mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Unhappy, afflicted.
E.
शर्म्मन् happiness, &c. with the priv. prefix.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Restless, anxious, unresigned.
E.
अ neg. शान्त tranquil.

f. (-न्तिः)
Anxiety, restlessness.
E.
अ neg. शान्ति tranquillity. So अशान्तता f. (-ता.)

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Unappeasable, not to be pacified.
E.
अ neg. शम to appease, ण्यत् aff.

n. (-म्यं)
1 Difference, dissimilarity.
2 Unsuitableness, (in medicine or diet,) unwholesomeness.
3 Disagreeableness.
E.
अ neg. साम्य sameness.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Not relating to or endowed with body.
E.
अ neg. शरीरिक bodily.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Perishable, transient, temporary.
E.
अ neg. शाश्वत eternal.

n. (-नं)
Want of government, anarchy, disorder.
E.
अ neg. शासन governing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Ungovernable: so अशास्य.
E.
अ neg. शासनीय or शास्य to be ruled, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ungoverned, undisciplined.
E.
अ neg. शासित governed.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Not conform able to sacred authority, heterodox, unscriptural.
E.
अ neg. शास्त्र scripture.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not conformable to sacred authority, heterodox, immoral, irreligious.
E.
अ neg. शास्त्रीय scriptural.

m. (-णः)
A secret.
E.
अ neg. षट six, अक्षि an eye, and ख affix; what is not seen by six eyes, that is, known or determined by two persons to the exclusion of a third.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Produced or occurring in the month Āṣārha.
m. (-ढः)
1 The month Āṣāḍha, commencing with the sun's entrance into Gemini, (June-July.)
2 A student's staff.
f. (-ढा)
A name common to the twentieth and twenty-first lunar mansion: see पूर्ष्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा.
E.
see आषाढ, the initial being made short.

m. (-ढः)
1 The month Āśāḍha, (June-July.)
2 A staff of Palāśa wood carried by ascetics.
f. (-ढा)
The name of two of the lunar mansions: see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा.

m. (-ढः)
1 The name of a month, (June-July.)
2 A staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried by an ascetic in the month Āṣāḍha.
3 The Malaya mountain.
E.
आषाढा the constellation, and अण् affix.
f. (-ढी)
The day of full moon in the month Āṣāḍha.
f. (-ढा)
The twenty-first and twenty-second lunar mansion; it is most commonly compounded with पूर्व्व^1 and उत्तरः see पूर्व्वाषाढा and उत्तराषाढा.
E.
अ neg. सह to bear, अण् and टाप् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314.

m. (-कः)
The month Āṣāḍha; also आषाढक.

m. (-कः)
The month Āṣāḍha: see the preceding, also अषाढक.

m. (-मः)
Absence of check or restraint, especially of the senses.
E.
अ neg. संयम restraint.

m. (-गः)
Absence of union or connection.
E.
अ neg. संयोग connection.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Disjoined, detached, separate.
E.
अ neg. मम् with लग्न connected.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Ignorant, unwise.
2 Not promising or contracting.
E.
अ neg. सं before विद् to know, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uncovered, exposed.
E.
अ neg. संवृत covered.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Free from doubt, certain.
n. adv. (-यं)
Certainly, verily.
E.
अ neg. संशय doubt.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Out of hearing.
E.
अ neg. सं with श्रव hearing.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Indifferent to, not attached to.
E.
अ neg. सम् with सक्त attached.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Unmixed with.
2 Separate, not living in common.
E.
अ neg. संसृष्ट united.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Not perfect, unpolished, rude, common.
2 Unintiated, not having gone through the proper rites of caste, state, sex or age.
E.
अ neg. संस्कृत perfect.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unknown, unacquainted, not known as acquaintances.
2 Not friends.
E.
अ neg. संस्तुत known.

n. (-नं)
1 Want, destitution.
2 Disorder, confusion.
E.
अ neg. मंस्थान station.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Disordered, irregular, not arranged or arrayed.
2 Not collected or assembled.
3 Destitute.
E.
अ neg. संस्थित placed together.

f. (-तिः)
See असंस्थान.
E.
as before, स्थिति stay.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Scattered, loose, straggling, uncompressed.
m. (-तः)
A form of array, loose or open order of troops.
E.
अ neg. संहत compact.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Irresistible, insuperable.
E.
अ neg. संहार्य्य to be repelled.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Part, not all, unentire.
E.
अ neg. सकल all.

ind.
Repeatedly, again and again.
E.
अ neg. and सकृत् once.

m. (-सः)
Repeated birth.
E.
असकृत् repeatedly, गर्भ the womb, वास abode.

mfn. (-क्थः-क्था-क्थं)
Without thighs.
E.
अ neg. सक्थि a thigh, अच् affix; also without the affix, असक्थि.

m. (-खा)
An enemy, an adversary.
E.
अ neg. सखिन् a friend.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Of a different family.
E.
अ neg. स with गोत्र family.

mn. (-ल्पः-ल्पं)
1 Sincerity.
2 Absence of predetermination.
E.
अ neg. सङ्कल्प will, vow.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not purposed, not resolved or determined on.
E.
अ neg. सङ्कल्पित purposed.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Firm, steady.
E.
अ neg. सङ्कसुक mutable.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Uncompounded, uncollected, unmixed.
E.
अ neg. मङ्कीर्ण collected.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Clear, open, broad.
m. (-लः)
A broad road.
E.
अ neg. and सङ्कुल crowded.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Not appointed, not agreed upon.
E.
अ neg. सङ्केत an agreement.

mfn. (-ङ्ख्यः-ङ्ख्या-ङ्ख्य)
Innumerable, exceedingly numerous.
E.
अ neg. and सङ्ख्य to be numbered.

f. (-ता)
Innumerability, immensity, infinity.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; or with त्व, असङ्ख्यत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Uncounted.
E.
अ neg. सङ्ख्यात numbered.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Innumerable.
E.
अ neg. सङ्ख्येय to be counted.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्का-ङ्गं)
Solitary, unassociated.
E.
अ neg. सङ्ग with.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Attachment to any object.
2 Association, connexion.
3 Proximity, contact.
adv. n. (-ङ्गं)
Eternally.
adj. mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Eternal.
E.
आङ् always, षञ्ज to move, अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Uneven, unequal.
2 Unattached.
3 Unpreferred, disesteemed.
4 Improbable, inconsistent.
5 Unaccompanied, unassociated with.
E.
अ neg. सङ्गत connected.

f. (-तिः)
1 Improbability, incongruity.
2 Not associating with.
E.
अ neg. सङ्गति congruity.

m. (-मः)
1 Separation, disunion.
2 Inequality.
3 Incongruity.
4 Not associating with.
E.
अ neg. सङ्गम union.

n. (-स्त्रं)
Heretical or heterodox doctrine.
E.
असत् untrue, शास्त्र a scripture.

m. (-नः)
A wicked or contemptible person.
E.
असत् bad, जन a person.

n. (-नं)
Putting on dress, armour, ornaments, &c.
E.
आङ् before षज्ज to dress, ल्यट् aff.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Insensible.
E.
अ neg. सज्ञा sign of life.

mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्)
1 Non-existent, not being.
2 Untrue, unreal.
3 Bad, vile.
E.
अ neg. and सत् being, &c.

f. (-यी)
Wickedness.
E.
असत् bad, ङीप् affix, and आय inserted.

f. (-ती)
A disloyal or unchaste woman.
E.
अ neg. and सती virtuous, &c.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Intimate union, meeting, junction.
2 Gain, profit, acquirement.
3 In logic, connexion or relation between two or more proximate terms and the sense they convey.
E.
आङ्, षद to go, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-तः)
A bastard.
E.
असती and सुत a son.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Wicked.
n. (-र्म्म)
Wickedness.
E.
असत and कर्म्म act; also असत्कार्य्य, असत्क्रिया, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ill done, done from improper motives, or in an unbecoming manner.
E.
अ neg. सत् good, कृत done.

f. (-त्ता)
1 Non-existence.
2 Untruth.
3 Wickedness.
E.
असत् and तल् added; also with त्व, असत्त्वं.

m. (-थः)
1 A bad road.
2 Evil practice or doctrine.
E.
अ neg. सत् good, and पथिन् a road.

m. (-हः)
Receiving unfit presents, or from improper persons.
E.
असत् and परिग्रह acceptance.

m. (-त्रः)
1 A childless man.
2 A wicked or disreputable son.
E.
असत् and पुत्र a son.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 False, untrue.
2 Lying, a liar.
n. (-त्यं)
Untruth.
E.
अ neg. सत्य true.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
A liar, speaking falsely, giving false evidence.
E.
असत्य and वादिन् who speaks.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Treacherous, base, wicked.
E.
असत्य untrue, सन्धि combination, अच् aff.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Improbable, unlikely. असत्य and सन्निभ like.

m. (-र्गः)
Evil company.
E.
असत् wicked, and संसर्ग association.

m. (-द् or -त्)
A name of INDRA.

m. (-ता)
A heterodox student.
E.
असत् untrue, bad, अधि before इङ् to go, to read or study, and तृच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wicked, following evil practices.
m. (-रः)
Evil practice.
E.
असत् and आचार observance.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wicked, vile, one who follows bad or heterodox practices.
E.
असदाचार and इनि aff.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Unlike, dissimilar.
E.
अ neg. सदृश् like.

m. (-हः)
Caprice, idle or childish desire.
E.
अ neg. सत् good, wise, &c. and ग्रह what is taken.

m. (-वः)
1 An evil temperament or disposition.
2 Nonexistence.
E.
असत् and भाव nature.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Low or degrading occupation or profession.
2 Wickedness.
E.
असत् wicked, वृत्ति practice.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Following evil practices.
m. (-रः)
Evil practices.
E.
असत् and व्यवहार practice.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Following evil courses.
E.
असद्व्यवहार and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Childless.
f. (-तिः)
Want of posterity.
E.
अ neg. सन्तति descendants.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Childless, having no posterity.
m. (-नः)
Want of posterity.
E.
अ neg. सन्तान progeny.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Displeased.
E.
अ neg. मन्तुष्ट pleased.

m. (-षः)
Displeasure.
E.
अ neg. मन्तोष pleasure.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
1 Undoubted, unsuspected.
2 Certain, confident.
E.
अ neg. सन्दिग्ध doubted.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Unapprised.
2 Uncommunicated.
E.
अ neg. सन्दिष्ट informed.

n. (-नं)
1 Want of an aim or object.
2 Disjunction.
E.
अ neg. सन्धान holding together.

f. (-न्धिः)
Want of union or connection.
E.
अ neg. सन्धि junction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Untied, unbound, at liberty, loose.
E.
अ neg. सन्धित tied.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Born, produced.
2 Affecting knowledge, conceited as a Paṇḍita or teacher.
3 Proud.
4 Unarmed.
E.
अ neg. सम with, &c. नद्ध the part. past. of नह to bind.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Non-perception of objects, not bringing them to the mind.
2 Remoteness.
E.
अ neg. सन्निकर्ष attraction.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Unperceived, undistinguished.
2 Remote, not near.
E.
अ neg. सन्निकृष्ट drawn near to.

f. (-धिः)
1 Absence, distance.
